sourceApproval.approvalScope: registeredLooks only; five pose files are not individually approved

styleIdentities.label: Dots
styleIdentities.description: 按已批准的简洁成对眼与圆润主体展示；不自动增加肢体、嘴或屏幕脸。
styleIdentities.descriptionEn: Preserve the approved rounded body and paired simple eyes. Do not add limbs, a mouth, or a screen face unless the reference visibly includes them.

styleIdentities.label: Grok Bot
styleIdentities.description: 保留柔和几何、成对胶囊眼与克制表现，点列/液滴方向按实际作品登记。
styleIdentities.descriptionEn: Keep the soft geometric form, paired capsule eyes, and restrained expression. Follow the specific reference for dot or droplet orientation.

styleIdentities.label: Meta Muse
styleIdentities.description: 保留包覆式轮廓和内嵌脸面，不替换为普通人物或熊玩偶。
styleIdentities.descriptionEn: Keep the wrapped silhouette and inset face. Do not turn it into a human character or a generic bear plush.

styleIdentities.label: 原创人物
styleIdentities.description: 原创精致 Q 版人物，头发、皮肤、衣物与实际姿态逐件描述。
styleIdentities.descriptionEn: Create original, polished chibi people with carefully rendered hair, skin, clothing, and the requested pose.

styleIdentities.label: 原创动物
styleIdentities.description: 原创物种形象，耳、口鼻、毛色、爪和尾部按作品实际画面描述。
styleIdentities.descriptionEn: Create original species-specific characters with clear ears, muzzles, coat colors, paws, and tails.

promptInventory.text: 蓝色短绒圆球形 Dots，正面有一对黑色椭圆眼睛，佩戴黑色头带和紫色耳罩的包耳式耳机；不加嘴、手脚或其它配饰。保持单体居中、透明背景。

A blue short-pile plush orb-shaped Dots character, front-facing with two black oval eyes and over-ear headphones with a black headband and violet ear cups. Add no mouth, limbs, or other accessories. Keep the single character centered on a transparent background.
紫色柔和圆球形 Grok Bot，右上区域有两枚成对、平行倾斜的白色胶囊眼；无嘴、无肢体、无配饰。保持圆润软几何外形和透明背景。

A purple soft geometric orb-shaped Grok Bot with a pair of parallel, slanted white capsule eyes toward the upper-right area. No mouth, limbs, or accessories. Preserve the rounded soft geometry on a transparent background.
奶油色包覆式 Meta Muse，暖桃色内嵌脸面，深色圆眼和轻柔微笑，短圆手臂与双脚自然下垂。保持完整包覆轮廓、正面静态站姿和透明背景。

A cream hooded Meta Muse with a warm peach inset face, dark round eyes, a gentle smile, short rounded arms, and small feet. Preserve the continuous wrapped silhouette in a front-facing still standing pose on a transparent background.
原创栗发 Q 版人物，细致分层的栗色头发、青绿色针织上衣、米白短裤和浅色运动鞋；双手在身前自然交握，表情温和。保持完整人物、正面站姿和透明背景。

An original chibi person with layered chestnut hair, a teal knit sweater, ivory shorts, and light sneakers. Rest both hands together naturally in front with a gentle expression. Show the complete person in a front-facing standing pose on a transparent background.
原创暖橙柴犬，立起的三角耳、清楚的茶白口鼻与胸腹色块、四爪坐姿和卷起的尾巴；表情温和。保持物种结构和透明背景。

An original warm-orange Shiba Inu with upright triangular ears, a distinct cream muzzle and chest, a seated four-paw pose, and a curled tail. Keep a gentle expression and clear canine features on a transparent background.
莓粉色短绒圆球形 Dots，佩戴透明粉色圆框眼镜，眼镜后的黑色椭圆眼清晰可见；无嘴、无肢体和其它配饰。保持正面单体与透明背景。

A berry-pink short-pile plush orb-shaped Dots wearing clear rose-pink round glasses, with black oval eyes visible behind the lenses. No mouth, limbs, or other accessories. Keep the front-facing single character on a transparent background.
浅薰衣草紫短绒圆球形 Dots，戴一顶黄色软布渔夫帽，黑色椭圆眼睛外露；无嘴、无肢体和其它配饰。保持正面单体与透明背景。

A light-lilac short-pile plush orb-shaped Dots wearing a yellow soft-fabric bucket hat, with black oval eyes visible below the brim. No mouth, limbs, or other accessories. Keep the front-facing single character on a transparent background.
青绿色软云形 Grok Bot，表面平滑柔和，带一对平行倾斜的白色胶囊眼；无嘴、无肢体、无配饰。保持软几何轮廓与透明背景。

A vivid green soft-cloud Grok Bot with a smooth, gentle surface and a pair of parallel slanted white capsule eyes. No mouth, limbs, or accessories. Preserve the soft geometric cloud outline on a transparent background.
蓝绿色圆角方形 Grok Bot，带一对平行倾斜的白色胶囊眼；无嘴、无肢体、无配饰。保持柔和几何外形和透明背景。
A teal rounded-square Grok Bot with a pair of parallel slanted white capsule eyes. No mouth, limbs, or accessories. Preserve the soft geometric silhouette on a transparent background.
玫粉色绒面包覆式 Meta Muse，暖桃色内嵌脸面、深色圆眼和微笑；短圆手臂在胸前抱着一束白色雏菊和绿色花茎。不要把静态持花姿势描述为动画，背景透明。

A rose-pink plush hooded Meta Muse with a warm peach inset face, dark round eyes, and a smile. Its short rounded arms hold white daisies with green stems at the chest. Treat this as a still pose, not animation, on a transparent background.
浅鼠尾草绿绒面包覆式 Meta Muse，暖桃色内嵌脸面、深色圆眼和微笑；双臂抱着一本竖直的合拢绿色书。书本是闭合的，不描述为正在阅读；背景透明。

A pale-sage plush hooded Meta Muse with a warm peach inset face, dark round eyes, and a smile. Both arms hold a closed green book upright. Keep the book closed and do not describe the character as reading; use a transparent background.
原创 Q 版人物，栗色高丸子头和自然垂落的发丝，穿暖黄色连帽衫、米白短裤与黄白运动鞋；微笑并抬起一只手挥手问好。保持完整人物和透明背景。

An original chibi person with a high chestnut bun and loose face-framing strands, wearing a warm-yellow hoodie, ivory shorts, and yellow-and-white sneakers. Smile and raise one hand in a greeting wave. Show the complete person on a transparent background.
原创 Q 版金发人物，短而蓬松的浅金发，佩戴透明圆框眼镜；穿浅蓝衬衣、米白针织开衫和浅蓝长裤，双手在身前自然交握并微笑。保持正面完整人物和透明背景。

An original chibi person with short fluffy blond hair and clear round glasses, wearing a light-blue shirt, an ivory knit cardigan, and light-blue trousers. Rest both hands together naturally in front and smile. Show the complete person on a transparent background.
原创奶油白猫，灰色三角耳与灰色蓬松尾巴，保留蓝色眼睛、粉色鼻头、清楚口鼻和细胡须；以四爪自然坐姿呈现，不佩戴饰物。背景透明。

An original cream-white cat with gray triangular ears and a fluffy gray tail. Keep blue eyes, a pink nose, a clear feline muzzle, and fine whiskers. Sit naturally on four paws with no accessories, on a transparent background.
原创灰白哈士奇，三角立耳、灰白脸部面罩、深色鼻头和蓬松卷尾清楚可辨；以四爪自然坐姿呈现，不佩戴饰物。背景透明。

An original gray-and-white Husky with triangular upright ears, a distinct gray-and-white facial mask, a dark nose, and a fluffy curled tail. Sit naturally on four paws with no accessories, on a transparent background.

assetFacts.note: The publication tree contains current Artwork originals, the brand mark, and seven referenced scene resources. Pending pose assets, unused static images, and earlier scene revisions remain byte-preserved under historical-runtime. The dots-actions and pets-actions WebP files each decode as one 1086×1448 yuv420p frame and have no alpha; they are static reference illustrations, not animation previews or sprite sheets. Local Pet plugin frame layouts are separate from official target documentation.
